name: Grimesilt Dig Site
summary: Dark Iron sentries patrol the Grimesilt Dig Site in the Searing Gorge. Ironforge's search for relics began here, and its surviving crew struggles to endure in hiding.

sections.title: A Contested Excavation
sections.body: Dark Iron sentries patrol the Grimesilt Dig Site in the Searing Gorge. Ironforge scholars first sent an expedition beneath the crags to seek relics. The native Dark Iron dwarves drove the excavators out and seized their equipment. Wounded and scattered, the original crew remains trapped in and around the pit.

faq.q: Who originally established the Grimesilt Dig Site?
faq.answer: Bronzebeard dwarves of Ironforge began the excavation. Their team came to unearth ancient artifacts beneath the Searing Gorge, but the Dark Iron dwarves ambushed them and drove them away.

faq.q: Who controls the dig site now?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron clan controls the excavation. They occupy the pits and guard the remaining tools and territory against any Ironforge attempt to reclaim the area.

faq.q: Are there any survivors from the original crew?
faq.answer: Yes. A few workers survived, including the injured excavator Dorius Stonetender, who lies near the pit floor. Another crewmate hides inside a nearby outhouse.

angles.text: For Bronzebeard dwarves, Grimesilt is a bitter reminder of the Dark Iron threat across the mountains and the dangers dwarven antiquities and archaeologists face in hostile lands.
The dig site marks an Ironforge endeavor broken by the Dark Irons. Beleaguered Alliance subjects wait for extraction in treacherous territory.
